rationale: Base config: trainer defaults tuned in the single-algorithm cards.
Higher learning rate: faster progress per rollout, tests the clip's protection.
Tighter clip: more conservative policy updates.
Looser clip: larger policy changes per rollout.
More epochs per rollout: better sample use, risk of overfitting a rollout.
Larger minibatch: half the gradient steps, smoother each.
Longer rollout (~36 shifts): fewer, better-averaged updates.
Lower GAE lambda: lower-variance, more biased advantages.
